title: Docs: Private upgrades prerequisites, maintenance windows, and diagnostics bundle for Support
author: Kira Thompson
description: Summary: Drafts customer-facing documentation for upgrading Redwood Private deployments (VPC + on-prem/air-gapped) with an emphasis on (1) prerequisites/prechecks, (2) planning maintenance windows and what to monitor, and (3) collecting a diagnostics bundle for Support when upgrades fail. This is intentionally written as “day-2 ops” guidance and avoids over-promising downtime guarantees; rollback behavior is described at a high level with clear constraints. Motivation: During beta rehearsals and early Support tickets (e.g., SUP-1842), customers asked for a single canonical doc covering the operator workflow: what must be true before starting, how to estimate and communicate maintenance impact, and what artifacts to provide Redwood Support/PS to shorten time-to-resolution. Content highlights: (a) Prerequisites checklist (cluster/Kubernetes minimums, storage class + snapshot capability, IAM/RBAC permissions, outbound connectivity requirements for non-air-gapped), (b) Maintenance window guidance (planning assumptions, what changes are expected, go/no-go checkpoints, typical failure points), (c) Diagnostics bundle collection and redaction guidance (what gets collected, where it is stored, and what Support needs), including a minimal “copy/paste” section for Support cases. Notes: This PR references installer commands as implemented/landing in the upgrade workstream; command names/flags were aligned with Installer team on Slack and updated based on review (see below). This doc is marked as “Beta” where appropriate so we can tighten language for GA.

notable_snippets: Prerequisites excerpt: "Before scheduling an upgrade window, run prechecks and resolve all failures. Prechecks validate Kubernetes version, node capacity, storage class behavior, snapshot permissions, and control plane reachability. Redwood Support will request the precheck report for any upgrade-related ticket."

Diagnostics excerpt: "Collect a diagnostics bundle immediately after a failed upgrade attempt (before retrying). The bundle includes: precheck report (JSON), upgrade step timings, recent Kubernetes events for relevant namespaces, and tail logs for control-plane + gateway pods. Share via your Support ticket or the secure upload link provided by Redwood."
review_conversation: Dev Patel (Support enablement): Can we add a short “What to include in your ticket” section with environment info (VPC vs on-prem, installer version, target version, timestamps, correlation id if available)? This helps triage a lot. Also please avoid saying “rollback is one-click” — Support has been burned by that expectation.

Kira Thompson (author): Added a “Support escalation checklist” block with required fields + example ticket template. Updated rollback language to “operator-initiated rollback (when supported)” and linked to rollback notes.

Connor O'Brien (Release Eng): Command names: the installer now uses `redwood-private-installer upgrade plan` and `... diagnostics collect`. Please update any references to `upgrade preview` or `support bundle` to match. Also call out that offline/on-prem upgrades require importing a signed bundle first.

Kira Thompson (author): Updated commands and added an air-gapped flow callout linking to offline bundle docs. Also added a note that Support may ask for the bundle manifest and signature verification output if import fails.

Rafael Mendes (SRE): Maintenance window section looks good. Can we add explicit guidance on what to monitor during the upgrade (pods readiness, API health endpoint, ingress/gateway error rate) and a go/no-go gate before moving to the next phase?

Kira Thompson (author): Added a “During the window” checklist (what to monitor + suggested cadence) and a “Stop and contact Support” section with common stop conditions (repeated job failures, schema migration marked forward-only, persistent image pull errors).

Vivek Kulkarni (PM): Please add a small disclaimer on limitations: no guarantee of zero downtime, and some downgrades may be blocked due to forward-only migrations. Keep it customer-friendly but explicit.
Kira Thompson (author): Added a “Limitations and expectations” section. Kept it brief and linked to rollback notes for details.

Jacob Stein (Diagnostics): For security: in diagnostics doc, add a redaction note (tokens, credentials) and state that the bundle may contain service logs; customers should follow their internal policy before sharing. Also specify where on disk the bundle is written and how to rotate/delete it.
Kira Thompson (author): Added redaction + storage location + cleanup instructions. Also included a note that Support can provide a secure upload path when email attachments are disallowed.
Connor O'Brien: LGTM after the command name fix. Thanks for aligning with the installer UX.
Dev Patel: Approved after ticket template addition.
